evidence: In-line transparent bin, cyclone assembly, rear purple filter cap, and pistol grip handle with red finger trigger are visible.
missing_evidence: Rear LCD screen interface and machine model markings are not visible to separate Dyson V15 Detect from Dyson V11.
contradictions: The visible finger trigger contradicts the button-operated V12 Detect Slim, and the in-line body layout contradicts the perpendicular V8 bin.
decision.retake: Take a photo showing the rear circular LCD display screen and any model badging on the motor body.

candidate_checks.evidence: Matches the in-line bin, cyclone form factor, and trigger operation, but cannot be distinguished from non-catalogue V11 without the rear screen or model labeling.
Target features a red trigger on the handle, contradicting the V12 Detect Slim's push-button control on the body and triggerless grip.
Target features an in-line horizontal bin layout aligned with the motor, contradicting the perpendicular bin orientation of the V8 family.
Target is a handheld cordless vacuum body, contradicting the spherical wheeled canister layout of the Big Ball.
Target lacks the CleanCompaktor mechanism and distinct body geometry of the V16 Piston Animal.
Target is a dry cyclone vacuum, contradicting the dual water tank upright design of the WashG1 wet cleaner.

o1.refinement_reason: Inspect the rear circular display to check for the V15 particle readout versus V11 mode display.
